import re

def parse(lines):
    iss = re.compile(r'^(?P<file>\S[^:]*):(?P<line>\d+):(?:(?P<col>\d+):)? (?P<message>.*?) \((?P<linter>[\w-]+)\)\s*$')
    tot = re.compile(r'^(?P<n>\d+) issues?:?\s*$')
    cnt = re.compile(r'^\* (?P<linter>[\w-]+): (?P<count>\d+)\s*$')
    caret = re.compile(r'^\s*\^\s*$')
    issues = []
    il = []
    counts = []
    cl = []
    kv = {}
    kl = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            cur = None
            continue
        if caret.match(l):
            skip.append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
        m = iss.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = {'File': m.group('file'), 'Line': int(m.group('line')), 'Column': int(m.group('col')) if m.group('col') else '', 'Message': m.group('message'), 'Linter': m.group('linter'), 'Source': ''}
            issues.append(cur)
            il.append(i)
            continue
        if cur is not None and cur['Source'] == '':
            cur['Source'] = l.strip()
            il.append(i)
            continue
        m = tot.match(l)
        if m:
            kv['issues'] = int(m.group('n'))
            kl.append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
        m = cnt.match(l)
        if m:
            counts.append({'linter': m.group('linter'), 'count': int(m.group('count'))})
            cl.append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
    blocks = []
    if issues:
        blocks.append({'name': 'issues', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': il, 'records': issues})
    if kv:
        blocks.append({'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kl, 'records': [kv]})
    if counts:
        blocks.append({'name': 'issues_by_linter', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': cl, 'records': counts})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
